quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangfeng Electronic Materials annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 volumes (annual report): main target products (aluminium, tantalum, titanium, tungsten-titanium and copper targets combined) sales volume 155,496.00 pieces/sets/kg (+13.98%), output 156,890.00 (+9.44%), inventory 28,778.00 (+5.09%); precision parts sales volume 922,826.55 (+135.11%), output 1,029,967.91 (+89.47%), inventory 269,998.56 (+65.79%). The company attributes the parts jump to a rapidly expanding product line, many new products completing development and continued sales ramp; vacuum valves and heaters moved from trial production to volume production, and it can mass-produce more than 40,000 part types (showerheads, Si electrodes and others) used in PVD, CVD, etch, ion implantation, lithography and oxidation/diffusion.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangfeng Electronic Materials annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Products (annual report): Jiangfeng's ultra-high-purity sputtering targets are in volume use at advanced technology nodes of globally known chipmakers; its 300mm copper-manganese alloy target output rose sharply, its high-density 300mm tungsten target for advanced processes is in stable volume supply, HCM tantalum and HCM titanium targets were developed and put into mass production, and its high-purity 300mm silicon target for advanced memory chips is in stable volume supply; its ultra-high-purity tungsten targets (3D NAND seed layer) are in volume use at several international memory makers. Precision temperature-control core parts for wafer thin-film deposition are ramping. R&D projects now in mass production include copper and copper-alloy targets, tungsten and tungsten-alloy targets, nickel and titanium targets, an EBO surface coating for CVD showerheads, an SLV high-vacuum L-type valve for CVD tools and high-purity yttria focus rings for advanced etch; a powder-metallurgy tantalum target is at the R&D stage. The company says it is the only domestic company with the core technology in several advanced target products (company claim).

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangfeng Electronic Materials annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Supply (annual report, company statement): demand for tantalum targets and rings and for copper-manganese alloy targets has risen sharply with high-end chip demand and the global supply chain is extremely tight; demand for ultra-high-purity tungsten targets has surged as AI and HBM reshape the memory market, with global supply extremely tight. The company says only it and leading multinationals master production of tantalum rings, copper-manganese alloy targets and ultra-high-purity tungsten targets (company claim).

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangfeng Electronic Materials annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Construction and capacity (annual report): construction in progress fell to RMB 1.43 billion at end-2025 from RMB 2.01 billion as self-built plants and equipment moved into fixed assets, which rose to RMB 2.88 billion from RMB 1.30 billion. The Beijing plant (budget RMB 200,000,000.00) reached 100.00% and is in use; the Hangzhou Ruisheng plant (budget RMB 243,000,000.00) was 55.90% invested and under construction; the Huanghu smart factory's core modules (automated warehousing, flexible automation cells, digital lifecycle systems) entered unit testing ahead of full-line joint commissioning.
quarterly_data.figure: CIP RMB 1.43 billion (from RMB 2.01 billion); fixed assets RMB 2.88 billion (from RMB 1.30 billion)

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangfeng Electronic Materials annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Plans and outlook (annual report, company guidance): through its private placement (approved by the SZSE listing review center on March 18, 2026) the company plans to build a semiconductor sputtering target production base in Korea, industrialise electrostatic chucks as a key part, and upgrade its R&D and testing center and regional service centers. The company says the precision-parts business is still at an early stage and that, as key parts are developed further and capacity is gradually released, its profitability will keep improving; it plans a sales, service and technical-support network covering Southeast Asia and Europe.
